name: Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun®
short_description: The Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 is a JomRun-organized race in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances on October 31, 2026.
ai_summary: The Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® takes place on October 31, 2026, at Drawbridge in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia. Organized by JomRun, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. Registration is currently open for those interested in participating.

faqs.question: When is the Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is scheduled for October 31, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, which will be held in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia. Runners planning to participate should mark this date on their calendars as registration is currently open for the race.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 can choose from three distance categories: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This variety allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to select the distance that best suits their training and personal objectives.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at Drawbridge, located in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia. This venue serves as the starting point for all three distance categories offered at the Terengganu Half Marathon 2026, making it a central location for runners traveling to participate in this JomRun-organized event.
